title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: worstcaseCost
text:
worst-case cost
worst-case cost
(definition)
Definition:
The highest possible use of resources of an
algorithm
, which occurs for the most pessimistic, or worst possible, input.
See also
average-case cost
,
best-case cost
,
amortized cost
,
worst-case execution time
,
adversary
.
Note:
